Significant internal reuse occurs across segments §3.2–8.1, which exhibit near-verbatim alignment (similarity score 0.99) with another homonymous poem, *Mañcadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 422, §10.2–15.1), and strong overlap with *Daṇḍadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 528, §3.1–8.1) and numerous other verse accounts in the *Therāpadāna* [DharmaNexus]. Portions of the opening verses (§0.3–3.4) are additionally shared with commentary passages in both parts of the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus].
